# `dry license`

Manage the commercial license (activate a token, show status)

## Help

```text
Manage the commercial license (activate a token, show status)

Usage: dry license <COMMAND>

Commands:
  activate  Verify and store a license token (argument: token string or a file containing it)
  status    Show the active license, its tier and expiry state
  help      Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
```
